name: epistemic-projection
description: Belief is projected from the Assertions on record. Silence is insufficient and never rejection; repetition is not corroboration; material disagreement is contested rather than decided.

cases.name: nothing on record is insufficient, not rejected
an unsupported Proposition has no support and no opposition
a projection declares that its score is not a probability
a projection reports the policy it ran under
BELIEF over an unbound variable is refused, not guessed
BELIEF SLOT over an unbound subject is refused
an unknown epistemic policy is named rather than defaulted
